[1/3] Plan: add a melee finisher - hits on enemies below 30% health deal +50% damage and restore 4 mana, rewarding aggressive cleanup.

impact_assessment.why: No reward for finishing wounded enemies; cleanup feels like a chore rather than a dopamine hit.
impact_assessment.benefits: Aggressive play is rewarded with bigger finishing hits and mana, increasing combo flow.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: damageEnemy signature unchanged, amount scaling internal; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: sim only, no save change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Unit test for finisher bonus and mana; existing tests still pass; gates.

[1/3] Plan: allow melee hits to interrupt an enemy's windup (stagger during windup for non-bosses), rewarding punishing telegraphs.

impact_assessment.why: Hitting an enemy during its telegraph currently does nothing to the attack, so windups feel like they must be dodged rather than punished.
impact_assessment.benefits: Adds a skill-based interrupt layer and a dopamine hit for cancelling big attacks.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: staggerEnemy signature unchanged; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: sim only; balance: only windup (not attack) and non-bosses, so telegraphed attacks still complete once started.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Unit test interrupt behaviour; existing tests pass; gates.
